study_name: DAYTRADE-001B: Extreme Downside 1-Minute Reversal Research Specification
hypothesis: Among the fixed Dow 30 research universe, an unusually extreme negative completed 1-minute return is followed by a positive short-horizon reversal that exceeds comparable non-event intraday returns after realistic execution friction.
study_notes: Event-study methodology only; not an executable backtest. Overlapping events may occur and must be reported.
direction_notes: Extreme negative 1-minute moves followed by possible positive reversal. Long-side reversal only. No symmetric upside/short hypothesis in v1.

universe.name: DOW30
survivorship_and_selection_limitations: Preset snapshot is from 2026; using it to study 2025 introduces survivorship and constituent-selection limitations.
DAYTRADE-001B accepts that limitation for this first bounded exploratory study.
This study cannot receive an evidence-confidence label above limited_but_usable_evidence solely on the basis of this dataset.
No production promotion may result directly from this study.
Historical Dow constituent reconstruction is out of scope.

dates_and_splits.holdout_access_rule: Holdout must not be parsed or evaluated unless validation earns the locked supported disposition
dates_and_splits.locked_parameter_discipline: Event threshold, horizons, costs, gates, universe, provider, and outcome definitions must not be changed after looking at development results without creating a new explicitly approved specification version.

timestamp_normalization.completion_rule: A 1-minute bar starting at T is not available until T+1 minute (at T+1 close)
timestamp_normalization.signal_availability: Signal is known only after the event minute is completed

event_definition.trailing_window_scope: previous 20 completed regular sessions for that ticker
event_definition.percentile_clarification: 0.1st percentile equals the bottom 1/10th of 1 percent (quantile 0.001), NOT the 10th percentile (quantile 0.10)

eligibility_and_timing.opening_minute_reason: 9:30 opening minute may embed overnight gap rather than pure within-session 1-minute move
eligibility_and_timing.latest_event_bar_rule: Full 5-minute outcome horizon must remain inside regular session; cannot cross session close
eligibility_and_timing.entry_timing: next executable 1-minute bar open (minute t+1 open)

primary_endpoint.name: 1_minute_forward_return
primary_endpoint.entry: next 1-minute bar open after event detection (t+1 open)

secondary_endpoints.name: 2_minute_forward_return
secondary_endpoints.entry: next 1-minute bar open after event detection (t+1 open)

secondary_endpoints.name: 5_minute_forward_return
secondary_endpoints.entry: next 1-minute bar open after event detection (t+1 open)

execution_friction.reporting_rule: report gross and all locked net scenarios

baseline.description: For each ticker, compare event forward returns with non-event observations from the same ticker and same minute-of-day within the same dataset split.

statistical_inference.description: Deterministic cluster bootstrap by ticker-session so multiple events from the same ticker/session are not treated as independent observations.

dispositions.rejected: Data and methodology are valid and sufficiently sampled, but the primary hypothesis has non-positive primary net expectancy or non-positive uplift relative to baseline.
dispositions.inconclusive: Insufficient event sample (<300 events), insufficient ticker breadth (<15 tickers), concentration gate failure (>15%), effect direction positive but CI crosses zero, or usable data coverage too incomplete for a reliable conclusion.
dispositions.invalid: Lookahead bias, future-data leakage, holdout opened before validation support, timestamp/availability semantics materially wrong, split contamination, silent provider/feed substitution, corrupted or unverifiable data, or execution timing uses event close.

governance.daytrade_multi_resolution_boundary: Tests 1-minute statistical phenomenon only; 133-tick and 50-tick data are unauthorized in v1
